task.description: Implement push notifications, deep link sharing, and campus map placeholder improvements.

subtasks.title: Push Notifications Setup
subtasks.description: Install expo-notifications. Create apps/mobile/services/notifications.ts that: requests permission, gets Expo push token, registers it via POST /api/notifications/register, and handles notification tap to navigate to event detail via deep link. Wire it into app/_layout.tsx on app startup.

subtasks.title: Deep Link Share
subtasks.description: The Share button in event/[id].tsx already does Share.share(). Now add a share button on each feed card in index.tsx. Also update app/_layout.tsx to handle incoming deep links: when the app opens via highlanderevents://event/:id, navigate to that event.

subtasks.title: Improve Happening Now Banner
subtasks.description: Make the Happening Now cards in the feed tappable — onPress should navigate to the event detail. Add a pulsing animation to the green live dot.

constraints: Use expo-notifications (install with: npx expo install expo-notifications)
Do NOT modify backend routes — they are working
